sections.body:

Monitor API costs; consider caching Lens validation results to reduce daily expense if no new signals are generated.

sections.body: Today the system generated no trading P&L across all agents. Manual trading, Blade, Crisp, and Edge all recorded zero trades and zero profit/loss.
